GhaAction.description: An action: a directory whose `action.yml` or `action.yaml` file names its inputs, its outputs and the runtime that executes it. A workflow step runs it with `uses`.

action_path.description: The metadata file's path from the repository root.

action_uri.description: The action's address on its forge without a ref: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>`, followed by the directory's path when the action is not at the repository root. A step's `uses` names it as `<owner>/<repo>/<path>@<ref>`.

inputs.description: The inputs under the metadata file's `inputs` key.

outputs.description: The outputs under the metadata file's `outputs` key.

using.description: The runtime that executes the action, its `runs.using` value.

GhaAction.title: GhaAction

GhaActionInput.description: An input under an action's `inputs` key.

default.description: The value used when a caller supplies none, written as a string even where the input's type is a boolean or a number.

deprecation_message.description: The message GitHub shows a workflow that still passes the input, the file's `deprecationMessage`; present only when the input is deprecated.

description.description: What the input, output or secret is for, as the file describes it.

input_id.description: The key a caller writes in its `with` map.

required.description: Whether a caller must supply a value.

GhaActionInput.title: GhaActionInput

GhaActionOutput.description: An output under an action's `outputs` key.

description.description: What the input, output or secret is for, as the file describes it.

output_expression.description: The expression that sets the output, the file's `value` key, such as one that reads an output of a job or a step.

output_id.description: The key a caller reads the output by.

GhaActionOutput.title: GhaActionOutput

GhaActionRuntime.description: The runtimes an action's `runs.using` may name.
GhaActionRuntime.title: GhaActionRuntime

GhaBypassActor.description: An actor who may bypass a ruleset, and when.

actor_id.description: The actor's numeric id; absent for an actor type GitHub takes no id for, such as DeployKey or OrganizationAdmin.

actor_type.description: The kind of actor, the REST field `actor_type`, such as `Team`, `RepositoryRole`, `Integration` or `OrganizationAdmin`.

bypass_mode.description: When the actor may bypass, the REST field `bypass_mode`, such as `always`, `pull_request` or `exempt`; GitHub's default is `always`.

GhaBypassActor.title: GhaBypassActor

GhaDocument.description: A document that holds the workflows, actions, rulesets and required status checks of one or more repositories.

required_checks.description: The status checks the rulesets require.

workflows.description: The workflows other than the reusable ones.

GhaDocument.title: GhaDocument

GhaInput.description: An input that a reusable workflow or an action declares, under the key a caller writes in its `with` map.

default.description: The value used when a caller supplies none, written as a string even where the input's type is a boolean or a number.

description.description: What the input, output or secret is for, as the file describes it.

input_id.description: The key a caller writes in its `with` map.

required.description: Whether a caller must supply a value.

GhaInput.title: GhaInput

GhaOutput.description: An output that a reusable workflow or an action declares for the job or step that calls it to read.

description.description: What the input, output or secret is for, as the file describes it.

output_expression.description: The expression that sets the output, the file's `value` key, such as one that reads an output of a job or a step.

output_id.description: The key a caller reads the output by.

GhaOutput.title: GhaOutput

GhaRepositoryRuleset.description: A ruleset: named rules that GitHub enforces on the branches, tags or pushes of a repository, or of every repository in an organization or enterprise that it targets.

bypass_actors.description: The actors who may bypass the ruleset.

enforcement.description: Whether GitHub enforces the ruleset, the REST field `enforcement`.

ref_name_exclude.description: The refs the ruleset leaves out, from `conditions.ref_name.exclude`, even when they match an included one.

ref_name_include.description: The refs the ruleset applies to, from `conditions.ref_name.include`: names or patterns such as `refs/heads/main`, or `~DEFAULT_BRANCH` or `~ALL`. A ref must match one of them.

requires_check.description: The status checks the ruleset's required_status_checks rule requires, each a concept of its own.

rule_types.description: The `type` of each rule the ruleset holds, such as `deletion`, `non_fast_forward`, `pull_request` or `required_status_checks`.

ruleset_id.description: The ruleset's numeric `id` in the REST API.

ruleset_source.description: The name of the repository, organization or enterprise that owns the ruleset, the REST field `source`, such as `<owner>/<repo>`.

ruleset_source_type.description: What owns the ruleset, the REST field `source_type`: a repository, an organization or an enterprise.

ruleset_target.description: What the ruleset applies to, the REST field `target`. Named ruleset_target because LOKF defines a target slot of its own.

ruleset_uri.description: The ruleset's page, the REST response's `_links.html.href`, such as `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/rules/<id>`.

GhaRepositoryRuleset.title: GhaRepositoryRuleset

GhaRequiredMixin.description: The field that says whether a caller must supply a value.

required.description: Whether a caller must supply a value.

GhaRequiredMixin.title: GhaRequiredMixin

GhaRequiredStatusCheck.description: A status check that a ruleset requires to pass before a change reaches a ref it targets, named by the context a check run must report.

check_context.description: The context a check run must report, the rule's `required_status_checks[].context`. Named check_context because LOKF defines a context slot of its own.

check_uri.description: An identifier for the requirement. GitHub gives a required check no address of its own; in a knowledge bundle the concept's `id` takes its place.

do_not_enforce_on_create.description: Whether a branch may be created although the check would otherwise stop it, the rule's `do_not_enforce_on_create`.

emitted_by.description: The top-level workflow whose job reports the check.

integration_id.description: The GitHub App the check must come from, the rule's `integration_id`; GitHub Actions is app 15368.

job_path.description: The ids of the jobs from the top-level workflow's job to the job that reports the check: one id for a job of the workflow itself, the calling job's id first for a job of a called workflow.

skip_conditions.description: What in the workflow can skip the job that reports the check, each written as its key's path in the file, such as `on.pull_request.paths` or `jobs.test.if`.

strict_policy.description: Whether a pull request must be tested against the latest code of the branch it targets, the rule's `strict_required_status_checks_policy`.

GhaRequiredStatusCheck.title: GhaRequiredStatusCheck

GhaReusableWorkflow.description: A workflow that other workflows call as a job, because its `on` key names `workflow_call`; it declares the inputs, outputs and secrets its callers pass and read.

inputs.description: The inputs under the file's `on.workflow_call.inputs` key.

jobs.description: The jobs under the file's `jobs` key.

outputs.description: The outputs under the file's `on.workflow_call.outputs` key.

permissions.description: The access the file's top-level `permissions` key gives every job's GITHUB_TOKEN. Absent when the file sets none, so the repository's or organization's default applies; a scope the map leaves out gets no access.

secrets.description: The secrets under the file's `on.workflow_call.secrets` key, by name only; no value is ever recorded.

triggers.description: The names of the events under the file's `on` key, such as `push`, `pull_request`, `schedule` or `workflow_call`.

workflow_path.description: The file's path from the repository root, as GitHub's build type writes workflow.path. GitHub reads no subdirectory of `.github/workflows`.

workflow_repository.description: The repository that holds the file, as GitHub's build type writes workflow.repository: an HTTPS address without `.git`.

workflow_uri.description: The file's address on its forge without a ref: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/.github/workflows/<file>`.

GhaReusableWorkflow.title: GhaReusableWorkflow

GhaRulesetEnforcement.description: Whether GitHub enforces a ruleset, as the REST field `enforcement` names it.
GhaRulesetEnforcement.title: GhaRulesetEnforcement

GhaRulesetSourceType.description: What can own a ruleset, as the REST field `source_type` names it.
GhaRulesetSourceType.title: GhaRulesetSourceType

GhaRulesetTarget.description: What a ruleset applies to, as the REST field `target` names it.
GhaRulesetTarget.title: GhaRulesetTarget

GhaRunnerEnvironment.description: Who hosts the runner a job runs on, as GitHub's build type records it.
GhaRunnerEnvironment.title: GhaRunnerEnvironment

GhaWorkflow.description: A workflow file in a repository's `.github/workflows` directory: the events that run it, the access its GITHUB_TOKEN gets, and its jobs.

jobs.description: The jobs under the file's `jobs` key.

permissions.description: The access the file's top-level `permissions` key gives every job's GITHUB_TOKEN. Absent when the file sets none, so the repository's or organization's default applies; a scope the map leaves out gets no access.

triggers.description: The names of the events under the file's `on` key, such as `push`, `pull_request`, `schedule` or `workflow_call`.

workflow_path.description: The file's path from the repository root, as GitHub's build type writes workflow.path. GitHub reads no subdirectory of `.github/workflows`.

workflow_repository.description: The repository that holds the file, as GitHub's build type writes workflow.repository: an HTTPS address without `.git`.

workflow_uri.description: The file's address on its forge without a ref: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/.github/workflows/<file>`.

GhaWorkflow.title: GhaWorkflow

GhaWorkflowInput.description: An input under a reusable workflow's `on.workflow_call.inputs` key.

default.description: The value used when a caller supplies none, written as a string even where the input's type is a boolean or a number.

description.description: What the input, output or secret is for, as the file describes it.

input_id.description: The key a caller writes in its `with` map.

input_type.description: The input's `type`, which a reusable workflow's input must state. Named input_type because a knowledge bundle reads `type` as the class of the concept.

required.description: Whether a caller must supply a value.

GhaWorkflowInput.title: GhaWorkflowInput

GhaWorkflowInputType.description: The types a reusable workflow's input may state.
GhaWorkflowInputType.title: GhaWorkflowInputType

GhaWorkflowJob.description: A job under a workflow's `jobs` key: steps that run on a runner, or a call to a reusable workflow.

calls.description: The reusable workflow the job runs, its `uses` value: `./.github/workflows/<file>` in the same repository, or `<owner>/<repo>/.github/workflows/<file>@<ref>`.

job_name.description: The job's `name`, which GitHub shows and its check run takes; the check run takes the job's id when it has none.

job_permissions.description: The access the job's own `permissions` key gives its GITHUB_TOKEN, in place of the workflow's. A called workflow can lower its token's access, never raise it.

runner_environment.description: Whether the job's runner is hosted by GitHub or by the repository's owner, as GitHub's build type records runner_environment for a run.

runner_group.description: The runner group the job's `runs-on.group` names.

runs_on.description: The runner labels from the job's `runs-on`: one label, a list, or the `labels` of a group. A runner must carry every one.

GhaWorkflowJob.title: GhaWorkflowJob

GhaWorkflowOutput.description: An output under a reusable workflow's `on.workflow_call.outputs` key, set from an output of one of its jobs.

description.description: What the input, output or secret is for, as the file describes it.

output_expression.description: The expression that sets the output, the file's `value` key, such as one that reads an output of a job or a step.

output_id.description: The key a caller reads the output by.

GhaWorkflowOutput.title: GhaWorkflowOutput

GhaWorkflowSecret.description: A secret under a reusable workflow's `on.workflow_call.secrets` key, by name; its value is never recorded.

description.description: What the input, output or secret is for, as the file describes it.

required.description: Whether a caller must supply a value.

secret_id.description: The key a caller passes the secret under.

GhaWorkflowSecret.title: GhaWorkflowSecret

required_checks.description: The status checks the rulesets require.

workflows.description: The workflows other than the reusable ones.
